  local alevel     = num(attacker.level, 0)
  local crit_chance= num(attacker.crit_chance, 0)
  local crit_mult  = num(attacker.crit_mult, 150)

  local maxhp      = hp

  local armor      = num(defender.armor, 0)
  local dlevel     = num(defender.level, 0)
  local delem      = defender.element or 'neutral'
  local resist     = defender.resist or {}
  local guarding   = (defender.guarding and true) or false

  local hits       = num(skill.hits, 1)
  local true_damage= (skill.true_damage and true) or false
  local seed       = num(skill.seed, 0)

  local absorbed = 0
  local crits = 0
  local resolved = 0
  local overkill = 0
  local killed = false

  local k = 0

    k = k + 1
    resolved = k

    local p = power - 20 * (k - 1)
    if p < 10 then p = 10 end
    local d = math.floor(atk * p / 100)

    local diff = clamp(alevel - dlevel, -10, 10)
    d = math.floor(d * (100 + 3 * diff) / 100)

    local crit = ((seed + 17 * k) % 100) < crit_chance
    if crit then
      crits = crits + 1
      d = math.floor(d * crit_mult / 100)
    end

    local immune = false
    if not true_damage then
      local pen = pen_pct
      if crit then pen = pen * 2 end
      if pen > 100 then pen = 100 end
      local ea = math.floor(armor * (100 - pen) / 100) - pen_flat
      if ea < 0 then ea = 0 end
      d = math.floor(d * 100 / (100 + ea))

    end

    shield = shield,
    overkill = overkill,
